adam.description: Adaptive Moment Estimation - combines momentum and RMSprop. Excellent general-purpose optimizer with fast convergence and good performance on most problems.

sgd.description: Stochastic Gradient Descent with momentum - simple and reliable optimizer. Often finds better final solutions but requires more tuning and slower convergence.

rmsprop.description: Root Mean Square Propagation - adapts learning rate per parameter. Particularly effective for RNNs and non-stationary objectives with noisy gradients.

adagrad.description: Adaptive Gradient - adapts learning rate based on historical gradients. Good for sparse features but learning rate decays aggressively over time.

adadelta.description: Adaptive Delta - extension of AdaGrad that reduces aggressive learning rate decay. No need to manually set learning rate, robust and parameter-free.

adamax.description: Adam with infinity norm - variant of Adam using infinity norm instead of L2 norm. More stable than Adam for problems with large or unbounded gradients.

momentum.description: Classical momentum-based SGD - accelerates convergence by accumulating velocity in gradient direction. Simple and effective with optional Nesterov acceleration.
